summary: Inter & Co filed a 6-K attaching a Notice of Relevant Equity Sale after Squadra Investimentos disclosed holdings of 16,056,009 securities, equal to 4.93% of Inter's Class A common shares, following São Paulo Bovespa trades dated September 8, 2026. The stake comprises 13,903,097 Brazilian Depositary Receipts (INBR32) and 2,152,912 Class A shares, of which 520,098 BDRs are lent out. Squadra explicitly states the purchases do not aim to change control or management. The CVM Rule 44 5%/10% threshold notice creates an overhang; watch for further accumulation above 5% or activist intent.
